archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY fused with HIGH-PRECISION SATELLITE TACTICAL (Archetype 1 + Archetype 4)
theme: Dark Mode Precision Earth Observation (Deep Obsidian Forest #0B130E, Emerald Radar #10B981, High-Contrast Flood Aqua #06B6D4, Amber Warning #F59E0B, Crimson Threat #EF4444)

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand tagline + radar stats + primary CTA left, live satellite flood radar simulation interactive map preview right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split login — positioning panel with satellite mission telemetry left, secure farmer credentials form right
entry_surfaces./register: branded split register — platform capability matrix left, role-selection & farm onboarding form right

layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto)
layouts.gis_dock_panel: w-full lg:w-[480px] xl:w-[540px] h-[50vh] lg:h-full overflow-y-auto bg-[#121F18] border-t lg:border-t-0 lg:border-l border-[#1E3A2B] p-6 space-y-6 custom-scrollbar

visual_enhancers.satellite_card_border: border border-[#1E3A2B] hover:border-emerald-500/50 transition-colors duration-200 shadow-lg shadow-black/40
visual_enhancers.glowing_indicator: relative flex h-3 w-3 inline-block mr-2

motion.fade_in_stagger: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
motion.reduced_motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion via motion/react hooks and standard CSS fallbacks

accessibility.apca_contrast: All text tokens strictly maintain >= 4.5:1 WCAG AA and APCA Lc 60+ against declared container surfaces.
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Interactive map controls, tab list, and drawer triggers have visible ring focus ring-2 ring-emerald-400 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All buttons, navigation tabs, draw tools, file inputs, and cards MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, e.g. data-testid='field-polygon-draw-btn', data-testid='run-satellite-analysis-btn').

hero_satellite_farm.description: High-altitude aerial view of agricultural fields showing boundary variations and water presence

flood_before_after_satellite.description: Satellite river and inundated agricultural floodplain imagery for before/after comparison slider

lush_cropland_optical.description: Aerial view of vibrant green agricultural parcel used for NDVI verification baseline

inundated_valley_flood.description: Extensive wetland and water spread over agricultural perimeter

header.spec: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B130E]/90 border-b border-[#1E3A2B] px-6 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between

map_view.spec: Leaflet container with polygon draw tool (Leaflet.draw / SVG vector layer), GPS locate, layer switcher (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 Optical, Land Cover, DEM Elevation, Soil Moisture, Permanent Water, Flood Inundation), opacity sliders, synced before/after swipe slider

pipeline_progress.spec: Real-time step-by-step checklist with status indicators (LOCATION -> SAR -> PERMANENT WATER REMOVAL -> CROPLAND ID -> SOIL/DEM -> SUITABILITY -> REPORT)

confidence_engine_card.spec: Weights display: SAR 30%, Temporal Change 20%, Historical Water 15%, Land Cover 10%, Optical 10%, Terrain 10%, Data Quality 5% with explainability badge

land_suitability_radar.spec: Score card 0-100 with sub-scores: Soil (82), Moisture (76), Terrain (91), Flood Risk (48), Land Cover (94), plus recommended crops with AI reasoning and risk mitigation

before_after_slider.spec: Side-by-side or split curtain slider comparing pre-flood baseline with post-event SAR flood mask

seed_ai_verifier.spec: Upload or sample selector with genuine/counterfeit classification, purity %, germination score, and seed batch diagnostics

instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark palette defined in surfaces (#0B130E background, #121F18 panels, #10B981 emerald accents, #06B6D4 cyan water accents).
Install leaflet and @types/leaflet: run 'cd /app/frontend && yarn add leaflet @types/leaflet leaflet-draw @types/leaflet-draw' if needed.
Include rich demo seed data representing Indian agricultural contexts (e.g. Punjab Wheat Fields, Godavari Delta Paddy, Assam Brahmaputra Floodplain, Vidarbha Cotton, Bihar Kosi River basin).

All analytical sections must emphasize explainability: include 'Why AgriGaurd detected this flood' with green checkmarks (✓) and warning icons (⚠), plus scientific disclaimers ('Remote-sensing based estimate — Field verification recommended').

Never display unhandled 500 errors or blank screens if backend calls fail; implement elegant fallback demo telemetry so user can explore all GIS tools, seed verifier, reports, and admin dashboards smoothly.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute for Playwright automated verification.
